title: Buzzwords
tagline: A shout-it-out word party game where phones are controllers and a TV is the stage.
stateNote: Described in the README. I haven't found a hosted copy that I can verify is yours.
problem: Party word games get stuck on one phone. Here every player has a phone, and the other team can slam BUZZ if the describer says the word.
audience: Groups of four or more with a TV or laptop.
contribution: It is my project, built as an installable PWA with room codes.
worksToday: Host, join by code on a phone, and show the display on a TV browser, per the README.
limitations: No verified hosted copy to link.
